summary.name: Xcode
summary.one_liner: Apple's integrated development environment for building, testing, debugging, and distributing apps across Apple platforms.
use_cases: Previewing SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit views
Writing and running unit and UI tests
Automating builds and deliveries with cloud CI
Testing apps on simulators and physical devices
summary.what_it_does: Xcode provides tools to develop, test, and distribute apps for Apple platforms, including simulators for Apple devices. It supports coding with models and agents from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI, and can add agents that follow the Agent Client Protocol and extend with tools via the Model Context Protocol. Xcode Previews let developers preview SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit views in a canvas, with live or interactive modes and settings for Dark Mode, orientation, and text size. Testing supports Swift Testing alongside XCTest, including XCUIAutomation UI tests and performance measurement. The debugger, Organizer, and Instruments cover breakpoints, memory leak inspection, and CPU, disk, memory, and GPU profiling.
notable: Coding agents and models from multiple providers via Agent Client Protocol and Model Context Protocol
Xcode Previews with live or interactive modes for SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit
Xcode Cloud built-in cloud CI/CD service
caveats: Runs on Apple platforms; development targets Apple devices only
Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing links to the Mac App Store
